verse.text: His preaching will turn the hearts of fathers to their children, and the hearts of children to their fathers. Otherwise I will come and strike the land with a curse.

video.title: The Hearts of the Fathers (Malachi 4:5-6) | Verse by Verse

reflection: Malachi's final words remind us that a father's heart set toward his kids isn't a nice extra—it's the hinge on which a family's whole future turns. That doesn't mean having all the answers; it means showing up, asking your kids real questions, and letting them see your heart, not just your rules. Turn toward your children today, even in some small way, and watch their hearts start turning back toward you.
